body:
## Claude Review

⚠️ **Needs attention** — Three issues from prior reviews remain unresolved.

---

### Bugs (unresolved)

**`packages/mobile/src/components/DevServerSwitcherScreen.tsx:145`** — `Alert.prompt` is iOS-only. Calling it on Android is a runtime crash with no fallback. Use a custom modal or text-input sheet instead.

**`packages/mobile/metro.config.js:43`** — `Number(process.env.BOARDSESH_METRO_PORT)` produces `NaN` when the env var is a non-numeric string. Value is sent to clients verbatim. Use `parseInt(process.env.BOARDSESH_METRO_PORT, 10) || null`.

### Package Responsibility Violation (unresolved)

**`packages/shared/graphql-client/src/constants.ts`** — `MAX_TRANSIENT_RETRIES` controls session-join retry logic in `use-session-lifecycle.ts` and is unrelated to the GraphQL transport layer. Exporting it from `@boardsesh/graphql-client` violates the one-responsibility-per-package rule. Move it to the web component or a dedicated constants module.

### Conventions (unchanged from prior review)

**`packages/mobile/src/lib/metro-target-store.ts`** — Uses `expo-secure-store` for Metro hostnames (non-sensitive dev data). CLAUDE.md reserves SecureStore for credentials; `AsyncStorage` is appropriate here.

**`scripts/lib/tailscale-hostname.ts` + `packages/mobile/src/lib/metro-discovery.ts`** — Both implement identical hostname normalization (same regex, same trimming/filtering). The script version should import from a shared utility.

### Missing Tests (unchanged from prior review)

`DevServerSwitcherScreen` has no tests — particularly the `ExpoDevLauncher === null` path and the `handleAddTarget` iOS-only alert flow.

`resolveTailscaleHosts()` in `app.config.ts` is untested; a format change in `tailscale status --json` would silently return empty arrays.

---
